general_information.Description: This course is an introduction to applied cryptography and its relationship to secure systems. Students will learn making, breaking codes and ciphers. They can have a good understanding of major concepts in applied cryptography: plain text, encryption, cipher text, block ciphers, decryption, public-key cryptosystems, hash functions, digital signatures, authentication, key management, and cryptographic protocols as a part of securing digital systems.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Student must get the certification of Applied Cryptography Specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination
general_information.Note: 1. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100% 3.Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & ((Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus) >= 5

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain cryptography from the information-theoretical perspectives and discuss the pratical aspects of modern cryptography.
Understand basic techniques and algorithms of symmetric cryptography via classical and modern symmetric ciphers
Understand the basic principles of asymmetric (or public key) cryptography including the RSA cipher algorithm, the Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and problems with key distribution and key management.
Understand the important role of cryptographic hash functions in modern cryptography and their applications in integrity protection.
